meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: A short disclaimer appears at the foot of every page.
It states that the publisher accepts no responsibility for decisions taken by readers.
clues: It states that the publisher accepts no responsibility
items.reason: 読者の判断について出版元は責任を負わないと記していると述べられています

sentences: One ramification of the ruling was an immediate rise in premiums.
Nobody in court had discussed insurance, and every policy cost more within a month.
clues: Nobody in court had discussed insurance
every policy cost more within a month
items.reason: 法廷では保険の話は出なかったのに、一か月で全ての契約が高くなったと述べられています

sentences: Stowage below deck is limited to four crates per passenger.
Anything more must travel on a later sailing, and the hold is sealed at departure.
clues: Anything more must travel on a later sailing
the hold is sealed at departure
items.reason: それを超える分は次の便になり、出港時に船倉は封じられると述べられています

sentences: The article relies on innuendo rather than on any documented fact.
It asks nine questions about a man's holidays and states nothing directly.
clues: It asks nine questions about a man's holidays
items.reason: ある人物の休暇について九つの問いを並べ、直接には何も述べていないと書かれています

sentences: She had one serious misgiving about signing the lease.
The clause on repairs worried her enough to delay the meeting twice.
clues: The clause on repairs worried her
enough to delay the meeting twice
items.reason: 修繕の条項が気にかかり、面会を二度延ばしたほどだと述べられています

sentences: Attendance is a poor yardstick for the value of a museum.
A small collection may teach nine children more than a crowded gallery teaches four hundred.
clues: A small collection may teach nine children more
than a crowded gallery teaches four hundred
items.reason: 小さな収蔵が九人の子に、混雑した館が四百人に教える以上を伝えうると述べられています

sentences: The launch was a debacle that cost the company two years.
The rocket failed at forty seconds, and the replacement took until 2019.
clues: The rocket failed at forty seconds
items.reason: 発射四十秒で失敗し、代替機は二〇一九年までかかったと述べられています

sentences: The varnish restores the luster of the wood without darkening it at all.
The surface catches the light again, and the grain shows as clearly as before.
clues: The surface catches the light again
the grain shows as clearly as before
items.reason: 表面がまた光を受け、木目も以前と同じようにはっきり見えると述べられています

sentences: The discovery forced a new paradigm on the whole field.
Textbooks written before 1990 explain the process in a way nobody now accepts.
clues: explain the process in a way nobody now accepts
items.reason: 一九九〇年より前の教科書は、今では誰も認めない説明をしていると述べられています

sentences: The exhilaration of the first descent stayed with him for weeks.
He could not sleep that night and told the story to everyone he met.
clues: He could not sleep that night
told the story to everyone he met
items.reason: その夜は眠れず、会う人すべてにその話をしたと述べられています

sentences: The prognosis depends heavily on how early the condition is found.
Nine of ten patients recover fully if it is caught in the first month.
clues: Nine of ten patients recover fully
if it is caught in the first month
items.reason: 最初の一か月で見つかれば十人のうち九人が完全に回復すると述べられています

sentences: The doctrine was not formally abandoned until the 1970s.
Every priest had to affirm it at ordination for four centuries.
clues: Every priest had to affirm it at ordination
items.reason: 四百年にわたり、司祭は叙階の際にそれを承認せねばならなかったと述べられています

sentences: He left the company of his own volition and without complaint.
Nobody asked him to go, and he wrote a friendly letter to the board.
clues: wrote a friendly letter to the board
items.reason: 誰も退職を求めておらず、取締役会に好意的な手紙も書いたと述べられています

sentences: The photograph became a catalyst for a national conversation.
Nothing had changed for nine years, and a law was passed six months after it appeared.
clues: Nothing had changed for nine years
a law was passed six months after it appeared
items.reason: 九年何も動かなかったのに、それが出て半年後に法律が成立したと述べられています

sentences: Open dissidence was punished severely throughout those difficult years.
Two poets were imprisoned for reading their work at a private gathering.
clues: for reading their work at a private gathering
items.reason: 私的な集まりで自作を読んだ詩人二人が投獄されたと述べられています

sentences: The repair was carried out with remarkable finesse and very little noise.
Not one tile was broken, and the guests upstairs never knew it was happening.
items.reason: 瓦一枚も割れず、上階の客は作業に気づかなかったと述べられています

sentences: The efficacy of the treatment varies quite widely between different age groups.
It helps nine in ten children and fewer than half of adults over sixty.
clues: It helps nine in ten children
fewer than half of adults over sixty
items.reason: 子どもでは十人に九人に効き、六十歳以上では半分未満だと述べられています

sentences: Patients follow a strict regimen of daily exercise and careful diet.
Each is given a timetable that sets out what to do at every hour.
clues: sets out what to do at every hour
items.reason: 一時間ごとの内容を定めた日程表が各人に渡されると述べられています

sentences: The dense foliage hides the house almost completely during the summer.
Only the chimney shows above the leaves between June and September.
clues: Only the chimney shows above the leaves
items.reason: 六月から九月は、葉の上に煙突だけが見えると述べられています

sentences: His timidity in large meetings was often mistaken for indifference.
He had strong views but never raised his hand when more than ten people were present.
clues: never raised his hand when more than ten people were present
items.reason: 強い意見を持ちながら、十人以上いる場では手を挙げなかったと述べられています

sentences: There was a tinge of green in the winter sky that evening.
It was mostly grey, and only just above the roofs did the colour change.
clues: only just above the roofs did the colour change
items.reason: 大半は灰色で、屋根のすぐ上だけ色が変わっていたと述べられています

sentences: The impeachment proceedings in the senate lasted almost six months.
Charges were read, witnesses were called, and members voted on each article.
clues: Charges were read, witnesses were called
items.reason: 訴追の条文が読まれ、証人が呼ばれ、議員が各条について投票したと述べられています

sentences: Officers found contraband hidden inside the fuel tank of the van.
Nine packets had been sealed in plastic, and no customs form mentioned them.
clues: Nine packets had been sealed in plastic
items.reason: 樹脂で封じた包み九つがあり、税関の書類にも記載がなかったと述べられています

sentences: A full feasibility study will take at least eighteen months to complete.
Engineers must test the rock, the costs, and whether the route can be built at all.
clues: Engineers must test the rock, the costs
whether the route can be built at all
items.reason: 岩盤と費用、そもそもその経路が造れるかを技師が調べると述べられています

sentences: He had the impudence to ask for a refund on a used ticket.
He had travelled the whole way and still complained about the seat at the counter.
clues: He had travelled the whole way
still complained about the seat at the counter
items.reason: 全区間乗ったうえで、窓口で座席について苦情を述べたと述べられています

sentences: The acquittal came after a retrial that had lasted eleven weeks.
He left the court without conditions, and the record was cleared that day.
clues: He left the court without conditions
the record was cleared that day
items.reason: 条件なしに法廷を出られ、その日に記録も消されたと述べられています

sentences: Propagation from cuttings is much quicker than growing these shrubs from seed.
A branch put in damp sand roots in three weeks and flowers the next year.
clues: A branch put in damp sand roots in three weeks
items.reason: 湿った砂に挿した枝が三週間で根づき、翌年には花をつけると述べられています

sentences: The pamphlet describes in detail the tyranny of the previous regime.
Courts took orders from one office, and nine newspapers were closed in a year.
clues: Courts took orders from one office
nine newspapers were closed in a year
items.reason: 裁判所が一つの役所の指示で動き、一年で新聞九紙が閉じられたと述べられています

sentences: A minor accident can precipitate a much larger dispute.
One scratched car in that yard led to four years of letters between the families.
clues: One scratched car in that yard
led to four years of letters between the families
items.reason: その庭での車の擦り傷一つが、家族間の四年の書簡につながったと述べられています

sentences: Guests were invited to mingle in the garden before dinner.
No seats were set out, and people moved between four or five conversations.
clues: people moved between four or five conversations
items.reason: 席は置かれず、人々が四、五の会話の間を移り歩いたと述べられています

sentences: It is an offense to brandish any blade in a public place.
Holding a knife above your head on a street is enough for an arrest.
clues: Holding a knife above your head on a street
items.reason: 路上で刃物を頭上に掲げるだけで逮捕に足ると述べられています

sentences: The name continued to elude him for the rest of the evening.
He could see the man's face clearly and could not say a single syllable of it.
clues: He could see the man's face clearly
could not say a single syllable of it
items.reason: 顔ははっきり浮かぶのに、一音も口にできなかったと述べられています

sentences: Students must replicate the experiment twice before writing it up.
Both runs have to give the same figure within five percent.
clues: Both runs have to give the same figure
items.reason: 二度の試行が五パーセント以内で同じ値を出さねばならないと述べられています

sentences: He allows himself to indulge in one good cigar a month.
He buys it on the first Saturday and smokes it slowly in the garden.
clues: He buys it on the first Saturday
smokes it slowly in the garden
items.reason: 月初めの土曜に買い、庭でゆっくり吸うと述べられています

sentences: A single broadcast can inundate the office with enquiries.
Four thousand calls arrived in two hours, and the lines failed twice.
clues: Four thousand calls arrived in two hours
items.reason: 二時間で四千件の電話が来て、回線も二度落ちたと述べられています

sentences: They managed to contrive a shelter from two sheets of plastic.
Nothing else was to hand, and it kept four people dry for the whole night.
clues: it kept four people dry for the whole night
items.reason: 他に何もない中で作り、四人が一晩濡れずに済んだと述べられています

sentences: A strike at the port could cripple the island's whole economy.
Nine tenths of everything sold here arrives through that single harbor.
clues: Nine tenths of everything sold here
items.reason: 島で売られる物の十分の九が、その一つの港を通って届くと述べられています

sentences: Few politicians openly espouse a policy of higher taxes.
Only two candidates named the word in their leaflets last year.
clues: Only two candidates named the word
items.reason: 昨年、ちらしでその語を挙げた候補は二人だけだったと述べられています

sentences: It took four of them to heave the crate onto the platform.
They counted to three and lifted together, and it still scraped the edge.
clues: They counted to three and lifted together
items.reason: 三つ数えて一緒に持ち上げ、それでも縁を擦ったと述べられています

sentences: Collectors covet the early editions with the misprinted cover.
One sold for nine hundred thousand yen, and three people bid by telephone.
clues: One sold for nine hundred thousand yen
items.reason: 一冊が九十万円で売れ、三人が電話で入札したと述べられています

sentences: He tends to embellish the story a little more each year.
The fish was one kilogram in 2016 and nine by the last telling.
clues: The fish was one kilogram in 2016
items.reason: 二〇一六年には一キロだった魚が、最近の話では九キロになっていると述べられています

sentences: The two gardens adjoin along a low stone wall.
You can pass a cup from one to the other without leaving your own ground.
clues: You can pass a cup from one to the other
items.reason: 自分の土地を離れずに、一方から他方へ杯を渡せると述べられています

sentences: Police may impound a vehicle left blocking the fire exit.
The car is towed to a compound, and the owner pays before it is released.
clues: The car is towed to a compound
the owner pays before it is released
items.reason: 車が保管場所へ運ばれ、所有者が払うまで返されないと述べられています

sentences: Deep snow will hamper the search for at least another day.
Dogs cannot follow a scent through it, and the tracks are covered every hour.
clues: Dogs cannot follow a scent through it
the tracks are covered every hour
items.reason: 犬が匂いを追えず、足跡も一時間ごとに埋もれると述べられています

sentences: A good mystery can engross even a reluctant reader.
Two pupils who had never finished a book read this one in a weekend.
clues: Two pupils who had never finished a book
read this one in a weekend
items.reason: 本を読み終えたことのない生徒二人が、週末でこれを読み切ったと述べられています

sentences: It takes only one counterexample to refute the general claim.
The statement says every swan is white, and a single black bird settles it.
clues: The statement says every swan is white
a single black bird settles it
items.reason: すべての白鳥は白いという主張は、黒い一羽で決着すると述べられています

sentences: You have to jiggle the handle before the door will close.
Small quick movements up and down free the catch inside.
clues: Small quick movements up and down
items.reason: 上下に小さく素早く動かすと、内側の掛け金が外れると述べられています

sentences: A long silence will usually ensue after such a question.
Nobody answers for half a minute, and then two people speak at once.
clues: Nobody answers for half a minute
then two people speak at once
items.reason: 三十秒ほど誰も答えず、その後二人が同時に話し出すと述べられています

sentences: Beetles infest the timber if it is stored while still damp.
Nine holes appear in a single plank, and the dust collects underneath.
clues: Nine holes appear in a single plank
items.reason: 一枚の板に穴が九つ開き、下に粉がたまると述べられています

sentences: Storms of this size inflict damage on every harbor along the coast.
Two moles were broken last winter, and nine boats were lost in one night.
clues: Two moles were broken last winter
nine boats were lost in one night
items.reason: 昨冬は防波堤二つが壊れ、一夜で船九隻が失われたと述べられています

sentences: The birds incubate the eggs for about nineteen days.
One parent sits on the nest while the other brings food.
clues: One parent sits on the nest
items.reason: 一方の親が巣に座り、もう一方が餌を運ぶと述べられています

sentences: Try not to squash the fruit at the bottom of the basket.
Put the heavy jars on top and the peaches will arrive as pulp.
clues: Put the heavy jars on top
the peaches will arrive as pulp
items.reason: 重い瓶を上に置けば、桃はつぶれた状態で届くと述べられています

sentences: Two auditors verified every entry in the ledger.
They compared each figure with a receipt and initialled the page afterwards.
clues: They compared each figure with a receipt
items.reason: 各数字を領収書と照合し、その後ページに署名したと述べられています

sentences: Low sunlight dazzled drivers on the eastbound carriageway.
Four cars slowed to walking pace, and two pulled onto the verge.
clues: Four cars slowed to walking pace
items.reason: 車四台が歩く速さまで落ち、二台は路肩へ寄せたと述べられています

sentences: The children squabbled over the last piece of cake.
They argued for ten minutes about a slice that was already cold.
clues: about a slice that was already cold
items.reason: すでに冷めた一切れをめぐって、十分言い争ったと述べられています

sentences: The painting was relegated to a corridor on the top floor.
It had hung in the main hall for years and now faces a fire door.
clues: It had hung in the main hall for years
items.reason: 長く大広間に掛かっていたのに、今は防火扉に向いていると述べられています

sentences: The society is strictly apolitical and takes no position on elections.
Its rules forbid any candidate from speaking at a meeting.
clues: Its rules forbid any candidate from speaking
items.reason: 規則で、候補者が会合で話すことを禁じていると述べられています

sentences: Patients should avoid strenuous exercise for six weeks.
Walking is fine; running, lifting, and digging are not.
clues: running, lifting, and digging are not
items.reason: 歩くのは差し支えないが、走る、持ち上げる、掘るのは不可だと述べられています

sentences: Perishable goods travel in a separate refrigerated van.
Anything that spoils within two days is loaded last and delivered first.
clues: Anything that spoils within two days
is loaded last and delivered first
items.reason: 二日で傷むものは最後に積まれ、最初に届けられると述べられています

sentences: His warning about the bridge proved prophetic within a year.
He wrote in March that the pier would move, and it did the following February.
clues: He wrote in March that the pier would move
items.reason: 三月に橋脚が動くと書き、翌年二月に実際に動いたと述べられています

sentences: The team grew complacent after four easy victories.
Training attendance fell, and two players stopped watching match videos altogether.
clues: two players stopped watching match videos
items.reason: 練習の出席が落ち、二人は試合の映像も見なくなったと述べられています

sentences: He was a fervent supporter of the canal project from the start.
He spoke at nine meetings and lent the committee his own office.
clues: lent the committee his own office
items.reason: 九つの会合で発言し、自分の事務所まで委員会に貸したと述べられています

sentences: Copying the register by hand was a laborious business.
Two clerks worked for nine months and filled four hundred pages.
clues: Two clerks worked for nine months
items.reason: 書記二人が九か月かけ、四百ページを埋めたと述べられています

sentences: The proposed timetable was ludicrous for a crew of only four.
It required nine deliveries in one hour at addresses twenty kilometers apart.
clues: It required nine deliveries in one hour
items.reason: 二十キロ離れた住所へ、一時間に九件届けることを求めていたと述べられています

sentences: The house is comfortable and welcoming without ever being ostentatious.
Nothing in it announces its price, and the furniture was mostly inherited.
clues: Nothing in it announces its price
items.reason: 値段を誇るものが何もなく、家具も大半が受け継いだものだと述べられています

sentences: Nurses clean the area with an antiseptic wipe first.
It kills bacteria on the skin so that the needle carries nothing inside.
clues: It kills bacteria on the skin
so that the needle carries nothing inside
items.reason: 皮膚の細菌を殺し、針が何も持ち込まないようにすると述べられています

sentences: The argument quickly descended into infantile name-calling on both sides.
Two senior officials repeated each other's words in silly voices.
clues: Two senior officials repeated each other's words
items.reason: 高官二人が、互いの言葉をふざけた声で繰り返したと述べられています

sentences: The novel is told by an omniscient narrator who judges everyone.
The voice knows what each character thinks and what will happen in nine years.
clues: The voice knows what each character thinks
what will happen in nine years
items.reason: その語り手は各人の考えも、九年後の出来事も知っていると述べられています

sentences: An inquisitive child will take any machine apart.
He removed the back of two clocks and asked what every wheel was for.
clues: He removed the back of two clocks
asked what every wheel was for
items.reason: 時計二つの裏を外し、歯車ごとに用途を尋ねたと述べられています

sentences: The irascible old man complained about every parked car.
He came out nine times in one morning and once let the air out of a tyre.
clues: He came out nine times in one morning
once let the air out of a tyre
items.reason: 一朝に九度も出てきて、一度は車輪の空気を抜いたと述べられています

sentences: The lid of the box is decorated with exquisite silver inlay.
Nine hundred pieces of wire form a pattern two centimeters across.
clues: form a pattern two centimeters across
items.reason: 九百本の線材が、二センチの幅の文様を作っていると述べられています

sentences: The shop caters to a small but discerning group of collectors.
Its customers can date a print from the paper alone and ask about the watermark first.
clues: Its customers can date a print from the paper alone
items.reason: 客は紙だけで年代を言い当て、まず透かしについて尋ねると述べられています

sentences: Shoddy workmanship on the roof caused the leak in the first place.
Half the nails missed the beams, and the felt was laid the wrong way up.
clues: Half the nails missed the beams
the felt was laid the wrong way up
items.reason: 釘の半分が梁を外し、防水材も裏返しに敷かれていたと述べられています

sentences: He cast a furtive glance at the clock behind the speaker.
He moved only his eyes and looked back at his notes at once.
clues: looked back at his notes at once
items.reason: 目だけを動かし、すぐ手元の紙に視線を戻したと述べられています

sentences: Traffic in the old center remains an intractable problem.
Nine schemes have been tried since 1985, and journey times have not fallen.
clues: Nine schemes have been tried since 1985
items.reason: 一九八五年以降九つの策が試され、所要時間は減っていないと述べられています

sentences: She grew despondent after the fourth rejection letter.
She stopped writing applications and left the last two envelopes unopened.
clues: left the last two envelopes unopened
items.reason: 応募をやめ、最後の二通は開封もしなかったと述べられています

sentences: She is adept at repairing instruments nobody else will touch.
Four workshops had refused the harp, and she had it playing in a week.
clues: Four workshops had refused the harp
she had it playing in a week
items.reason: 四つの工房が断った竪琴を、一週間で鳴るようにしたと述べられています

sentences: The inquiry called the delay reprehensible but stopped short of calling it criminal.
Nine warnings had been ignored, and the repair could have been made in a day.
clues: the repair could have been made in a day
items.reason: 九度の警告が無視され、修理は一日でできたはずだと述べられています

sentences: The market has been volatile since the announcement in June.
Prices have moved more than four percent on nine separate days.
clues: Prices have moved more than four percent
items.reason: 九つの日に、価格が四パーセント以上動いたと述べられています

sentences: His prescient memo warned of the shortage two years early.
He named the exact component that later stopped nine production lines.
clues: that later stopped nine production lines
items.reason: 後に九つの生産線を止めた部品を、まさに名指ししていたと述べられています

sentences: The committee summarily rejected all three proposals at its first meeting.
No discussion was recorded, and the decision took four minutes.
items.reason: 議論は記録されず、決定は四分で済んだと述べられています

sentences: He smiled wryly and said nothing about the mistake.
One side of his mouth moved, and everyone understood what he thought.
clues: One side of his mouth moved
items.reason: 口の片側が動き、それで彼の考えが皆に伝わったと述べられています

sentences: The chairman was conspicuously absent from the second meeting.
His name card stayed on an empty seat in the middle of the table.
clues: His name card stayed on an empty seat
in the middle of the table
items.reason: 卓の中央の空席に、彼の名札が残っていたと述べられています

sentences: The fox watched the farmhouse warily from the edge of the field.
It kept to the hedge, stopped every few steps, and never crossed the open ground.
clues: It kept to the hedge, stopped every few steps
items.reason: 生け垣沿いに数歩ごとに止まり、開けた地面は渡らなかったと述べられています

items.sense: (質問などを)どんどん始めた
sentences: The reporters fired away as soon as the door opened.
Nine questions came in the first minute, and he answered none of them.
clues: Nine questions came in the first minute
items.reason: 最初の一分で九つの問いが飛び、彼は一つも答えなかったと述べられています

sentences: He mulled over the offer for a fortnight before replying.
He wrote out the advantages twice and asked two friends for their view.
clues: He wrote out the advantages twice
asked two friends for their view
items.reason: 利点を二度書き出し、友人二人にも意見を求めたと述べられています

sentences: The gale blew away half the tiles on the south side.
They were found in the next field, and rain came straight into the loft.
clues: They were found in the next field
rain came straight into the loft
items.reason: 瓦は隣の畑で見つかり、雨が屋根裏へ直に入ったと述べられています

sentences: Part of the tunnel caved in during the heavy rain.
Nine meters of roof fell to the floor and blocked the passage completely.
clues: Nine meters of roof fell to the floor
items.reason: 天井の九メートル分が落ち、通路をふさぎ切ったと述べられています

sentences: The whole class cracked up when the model collapsed.
Even the teacher had to sit down, and nobody could speak for a minute.
